name: gadmin
description: Google Workspace administration: Cloud Identity, Chrome management and policy, Groups Settings, licensing, reports, alerts, Vault, reseller and Cloud Search admin.

allow_writes.title: Allow write tools
allow_writes.description: Modifying and deleting tools are listed only when this is on, and every change still asks first unless confirmation is off.

confirmation.title: Confirm before changes
confirmation.description: every-change: ask before any change (recommended). destructive-only: ask only before deleting, sending to other people, sharing or permission changes, security changes, device commands, publishing, refunds and whole-content replacement. off: never ask.

toolset.title: Toolset
toolset.description: Which tools this server lists. all: every tool (the default). google: the set that matches Google's own MCP server. curated: hand-written and gateway tools. Applies on restart.

token_dir.title: Token directory (optional)
token_dir.description: Where OAuth tokens are stored. Leave empty for ~/.google-services-mcps.

admin_subject.title: Workspace super admin email (admin tools only)
admin_subject.description: A super admin in your domain. The admin server impersonates this account through domain-wide delegation.

service_account_key_file.title: Service account key file (admin tools only)
service_account_key_file.description: JSON key of the service account that has domain-wide delegation for the admin scopes.
